text: PolicyClaimsDB holds real policyholder and claims data, so this lesson hardens it with three concrete, verifiable controls.
Transparent Data Encryption, Azure AD authentication in place of a shared SQL login, and SQL Auditing to a dedicated storage account, each one checked, not assumed.
A quick query against sys.dm_database_encryption_keys confirms encryption state 3, actually encrypted, before it goes in the sign-off.
The claims-processing app gets its own Azure AD identity as a contained database user, replacing a shared SQL login nobody wants sitting in a config file.
Security is locked down. Next: the disaster-recovery backbone -- active geo-replication and an auto-failover group.
